<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_BecomingAParent" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/becoming-a-parent">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_BecomingAParent" name="Becoming A Parent" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_MaternityLeave" name="Maternity leave planning started">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FetchModels" name="Fetch information about potential models">
      <bpmn:documentation>Duration in months and split between parents.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_SelectModel" name="Select model">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectInfo" name="Collect relevant information">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NotifySocialSecurity" name="Notify Social Security in time">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NotifyCompany" name="Notify Company in time">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherCompanyInfo" name="Gather information from companies">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_EndOfPeriod" name="End of leave period reached">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerEventDefinition_EndOfPeriod"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_DecideExtension" name="Decide about extension">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Extension" name="Extension requested?" default="Flow_NoExtension">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Extend</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoExtension</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ExtendLeave" name="Extend maternity leave">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Extend</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Extended" name="Leave extended">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NotExtended" name="Leave ended">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoExtension</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_MaternityLeave" targetRef="Task_FetchModels"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_FetchModels" targetRef="UserTask_SelectModel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="UserTask_SelectModel" targetRef="Task_CollectInfo"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_CollectInfo" targetRef="Task_NotifySocialSecurity"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_NotifySocialSecurity" targetRef="Task_NotifyCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_NotifyCompany" targetRef="Task_GatherCompanyInfo"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_GatherCompanyInfo" targetRef="Event_EndOfPeriod"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Event_EndOfPeriod" targetRef="UserTask_DecideExtension"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="UserTask_DecideExtension" targetRef="Gateway_Extension"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Extend" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Extension" targetRef="Task_ExtendLeave">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoExtension" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Extension" targetRef="EndEvent_NotExtended"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_ExtendLeave" targetRef="EndEvent_Extended"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
